# Map of the rules

Section N of the writing rules maps to section N of the code rules.

| Section | Writing (W) | Code (C) | W rules | C rules |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Words | Identifiers (STE: Words) | 8 | 8 |
| 2 | Noun clusters | Compound names (STE: Noun clusters) | 3 | 3 |
| 3 | Verbs | Functions (STE: Verbs) | 4 | 4 |
| 4 | Sentences | Statements and expressions (STE: Sentences) | 5 | 5 |
| 5 | Procedures | Functions, files, and control flow (STE: Procedures) | 6 | 7 |
| 6 | Descriptive writing | Self-explaining code (STE: Descriptive writing) | 4 | 6 |
| 7 | Safety instructions | Risk, errors, and logs (STE: Safety instructions) | 4 | 4 |
| 8 | Punctuation and word counts | Formatting and counts (STE: Punctuation and word counts) | 3 | 4 |
| 9 | Writing practices | Consistency and change (STE: Writing practices) | 5 | 5 |
